article.title: Allowing unauthorised persons to drive vehicles.
article.content: Whenever, being the owner or person in charge of a motor vehicle, causes, or permits, any other person who does not satisfy the provisions of section 3 or section 4 to drive the vehicle shall be punishable with imprisonment for a term which may extend to three months, or with fine 4[of five thousand rupees], or with both.
article.html:
180Allowing unauthorised persons to drive vehicles.

Section 180 · Chapter XIII · page 101 of the Act

Whenever, being the owner or person in charge of a motor vehicle, causes, or permits, any other person who does not satisfy the provisions of section 3 or section 4 to drive the vehicle shall be punishable with imprisonment for a term which may extend to three months, or with fine 4[of five thousand rupees], or with both.

4 Subs. by Act 32 of 2019, s. 62, for “which may extend to one thousand rupees” (w.e.f. 1-9-2019).
